Accessibility

This is the accessibility statement (Barrierefreiheitserklärung) for paulwerner.net.

Voluntary, Not Required

The German Accessibility Strengthening Act (Barrierefreiheitsstärkungsgesetz – BFSG) has applied since 28 June 2025. It does not oblige this website to be accessible: the site is operated by a sole proprietor who qualifies as a micro-enterprise under Sec. 2 no. 17 BFSG — fewer than ten employees and an annual turnover or balance sheet total of no more than EUR 2 million — and Sec. 3 (3) BFSG exempts micro-enterprises providing services from the Act's requirements.

Conformance here is therefore a deliberate choice, not a legal duty. Accessibility is part of what this practice sells, and a site that did not meet the standard it recommends would not be worth much as evidence.

Conformance Status

This website aims to conform fully to the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 at level AA. To the best of our assessment, it currently does.

The assessment covers all pages of paulwerner.net: the home page, imprint, privacy policy, disclaimer, and this statement. It was carried out on 25 July 2026 by self-evaluation — there has been no external audit and no certification. The method combined automated testing (axe-core and Lighthouse against every page) with manual checks: keyboard-only navigation of every interactive element, verification of heading structure and landmarks, measurement of the contrast ratio of every colour pair in the site's palette, and confirmation that animation respects the reduced-motion preference.

Known Limitations

Despite the aim above, the following limitations are known:

  • Self-assessment only. No independent audit has been commissioned, and no testing has been done with users of assistive technology. Automated tools detect only a portion of possible barriers.
  • The blog is a separate case. The blog at blog.paulwerner.net is built on the same standard and its templates were reviewed in the same pass, but published articles can contain images, embedded media, or code samples whose accessibility depends on the individual post. Article content is not covered by this statement.
  • English only. All pages are published in English. That is not a WCAG failure, but it is a genuine barrier for visitors who read German only.
  • Decorative imagery. The atmospheric hero image and the grain overlay carry no information and are hidden from assistive technology by design. If you feel context is missing as a result, please say so.

Feedback and Contact

If you encounter a barrier on this website, or need content in a different form, write to contact@paulwerner.net. Including the page address and a short description of what went wrong helps most. Messages are answered within five working days, and confirmed barriers are fixed as quickly as is practical.

Enforcement Procedure

Market surveillance for the accessibility of products and services under the BFSG is carried out by the Marktüberwachungsstelle der Länder für die Barrierefreiheit von Produkten und Dienstleistungen (MLBF AöR), which has been operating since 26 September 2025:

MLBF AöR
Carl-Miller-Straße 6
39112 Magdeburg, Germany
kontakt@mlbf-barrierefrei.de
mlbf-barrierefrei.de
Kontaktformular für Unternehmen (contact form for businesses)

Because this website falls under the micro-enterprise exemption described above, it is not subject to that authority's supervision. The authority is named here for completeness. Note also that the conciliation body under Sec. 16 of the Disability Equality Act (BGG) and the Federal Monitoring Body for Accessibility of Information Technology are responsible for public-sector bodies, not for a private website like this one.
